query: SELECT e.id,e.canonical_uri FROM discovery_entries e JOIN discovery_sources s ON s.id=e.source_id JOIN discovery_sources t ON t.id=$1 LEFT JOIN discovery_video_details v ON v.entry_id=e.id WHERE e.kind='video' AND e.state<>'withdrawn' AND e.valid_until<=clock_timestamp() AND ($2 OR s.origin=t.origin) AND ($3 OR v.channel_uri=$4) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_jobs j WHERE j.target_uri=e.canonical_uri AND (j.withdrawn OR j.leased_until>clock_timestamp())) ORDER BY e.valid_until,e.id LIMIT 1
